communes: Luz De Tavira E Santo Estêvão
Santa Catarina Da Fonte Do Bispo

blurb.text: A DOC in the Algarve centered on the Tavira municipality and reaching the Spanish border. Allowed grapes include Touriga Nacional, Castelão, Negra Mole, Arinto, Síria, Tamarez and Diagalves.
